mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE lang = #{lang}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages (name, color, content, lang, likes, created_at, user_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{color}, #{content}, #{lang}, #{likes}, #{createdAt}, #{userId})
INSERT INTO message_likes (message_id, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{userId}, CURDATE())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM message_likes WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE messages SET likes = likes + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE messages SET likes = GREATEST(likes - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
